door_versions.note: TYPE-SCOPED, 2026-09-28 (Andriy, off CK7744 in the panel: 'two door heights, one for gola, one for handle'). Registry.lookup now reads door_versions from the unit type first and the family second - the per-type recording the 2026-08-24 note asked for, so the plain tall sections of the same family (no gola printed) still get none. full_mm / gola_mm are the whole column, H and H - 30, because that is the arithmetic the panel does; shown_* are the numbers the page prints for the front that changes, and the panel labels the choice with them. joint false: the carcass-joint split of the base units (Generator.gola_joint!) is written for a recess at the top and does not apply to a recess part-way up a column.

front_layout.split_note: SPLIT 2026-09-28 (Andriy: 'the upper door is drawn' - the rule C92640 at H.234 got on 2026-08-27, carried to every remainder column). The page prints the SUM and calls the top door custom-sized. The openings are the ESTABLISHED ones: 600 for an oven H.60 (claude/findings-2026-08-25-tall-h210-appliance-columns.md 1), a second 600 for the microwave/double oven as C92640's render showed - HERE BY ANALOGY, NOT RE-READ on this page (learned rule 4) - and 460 for an oven H.46. The door is DERIVED: remainder minus openings, the same number in both executions. The real door height is set by the appliance at order time (7612: Thermador MEDMC301WS wants a 1248 flush opening in CK7744, i.e. a 492 door).
